source_name: Check if your university or college can award a degree
evidence_used: Routes degree-recognition checks to the OfS Register (England), NI Executive, Scottish Government and Wales recognised-body list; explicitly distinguishes a teaching college from the body awarding the degree.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: A UK-wide 140-provider inventory requires deduplication across four legal systems and separate handling of recognised bodies versus listed/delivery bodies.

evidence_used: Reports 425 registered providers; register entries cover registration, covered organisations, trading names, degree-awarding powers/level, university-title rights, fee limits and conditions. OfS says its most recent Recognised Bodies Order was made in June 2020.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: 425 is the broad registered-provider count, not the university/degree-awarding target. The 2020 order and present register require reconciliation.

evidence_used: The official download endpoint was parsed as a 65-chunk register with legal/provider names, UKPRN, website, location, registration category, degree-awarding powers and university-title fields.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Only the first chunk was retrieved in the prior attempt; full rows have not been extracted or filtered. Do not infer that the source is blocked.

evidence_used: Documents GET /api/Provider, /api/Provider/{ukprn} and /api/Provider/Name.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Schema does not itself provide the proposed UK 140 selection; current provider status and DAP/title must be checked.

evidence_used: JSON name/alias response reports 11 chunks and includes UKPRN and RegistrationStatus.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Multiple aliases repeat a UKPRN; deduplicate by UKPRN and retain aliases. Only chunk 0 retrieved; name-row count is not provider count.

evidence_used: Schedule names English recognised bodies authorised to award degrees; OfS guide identifies this as its most recent Recognised Bodies Order.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: The schedule is from 2020. Cross-check current registration, aliases and status against OfS; it is not a current campus/catalogue inventory.

evidence_used: States 19 autonomous Scottish higher-education institutions; lists 18 recognised bodies with degree-awarding powers and identifies Glasgow School of Art as a validator/teaching institution without its own DAP.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Counts refer to different categories. Recognised list includes UK-wide bodies; geographic provider universe needs location and cross-border deduplication.

evidence_used: Lists 11 recognised bodies.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: List includes UK-wide bodies (e.g. Open University and Royal College of Nursing) and University of Wales; it is an awarding-body list, not a count of Welsh campus providers.

evidence_used: Direct path returned a GOV.WALES not-found page; the GOV.UK recognised-bodies list linked from the official GOV.UK guide loaded successfully.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Do not retry the stale direct path as the sole source; use GOV.UK and verify any replacement Welsh Government page.

source_name: Higher Education Policy: recognised and listed bodies
source_authority_type: Northern Ireland Department for the Economy
evidence_used: Lists four current recognised bodies and, as of August 2026, 17 listed bodies; distinguishes the five public providers from the recognised-body list.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Listed bodies teach programmes whose awards are made by recognised bodies; do not treat each as a separate degree-awarding university. The list changes annually.

source_authority_type: Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Agency (TEQSA)
evidence_used: Current page calls the register authoritative and shows 221 total providers, including 44 Australian University providers (44 SAA, 0 non-SAA), 169 Institute of Higher Education, and 8 University College.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Current site total differs from the 273-entry data.gov.au resource; the filtered Australian University category count is 44 in both. Reconcile total-resource semantics only if broader categories are used.

evidence_used: Resource reports 273 entries and exposes provider ID, legal/trading names, category, address, website, registration status/description/renewal, self-accreditation, CRICOS and related fields; metadata reported update 2026-10-20.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Resource total (273) differs from the current TEQSA website total (221); filtered university rows corroborate 44.

source_name: TQNR filtered Australian University API response
source_authority_type: Australian Government data.gov.au API / TEQSA data
evidence_used: Returned 44 Category=Australian University rows with provider ID, provider/legal name, trading name, website, RegistrationStatus and CRICOS Registration; all 44 RegistrationStatus values were Active.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: CRICOS field is blank for legacy Adelaide and UniSA records; Adelaide University PRV14404 is also listed. Preserve all source rows pending merger/transition resolution.
verification_status: 44 SOURCE ROWS VERIFIED; CAMPUS/COURSE REVIEW PENDING

source_name: Preliminary trends in higher education data
evidence_used: 2026 provider-level preliminary trends are stated as at 2026-05-01 and limited to Table A/B universities; records include Adelaide University alongside legacy Adelaide and UniSA rows.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Statistics table is not a regulator register; use only as corroboration and merger/status evidence, not as the university-universe master.

source_authority_type: Universities New Zealand – Te Pōkai Tara / authorised sector source
evidence_used: Names eight universities and links each to its official website.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: The page is a sector universe source, not a national-identifier export; no campus, faculties, course catalogue, fees or admissions sources were individually surveyed.
verification_status: EIGHT NAMES/WEBSITES VERIFIED; REMAINING FIELDS NOT_SURVEYED

access_result: READ_OK; CURRENT LIST AND ARCHIVE VISIBLE
evidence_used: Current list contains 18 HEIs that work with HEA under statute or receive core funding; includes 5 TUs, 7 IUA universities, RCSI, 2 institutes of technology, 2 specialist colleges and Royal Irish Academy.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: This HEA engagement/funding list is not the complete universe of all QQI-validated private providers. Exact provider status and degree-awarder relationship need institution-level verification.
verification_status: 18 HEA ROWS INVENTORIED; CLASSIFICATION CROSSCHECK PARTIAL

evidence_used: HEA states five established TUs: TU Dublin, MTU, TUS, ATU and SETU.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Keep technological universities as their own provider class even though a 2022 gov.ie publication places them under a “Publicly-funded universities” heading.

source_authority_type: Irish Universities Association (IUA) / authorised sector source
evidence_used: IUA identifies its seven member universities; consistent with the seven statutory/established university institutions used as the traditional-university group.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: IUA is a sector association, not the regulator; RCSI is separately classified because it is outside the seven IUA members but has authorised university title.

evidence_used: Defines constituent universities and provides for DCU, Trinity/University of Dublin and UL; used with statutory history for the seven traditional university group.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Use current legal names and aliases; do not create separate teaching-provider rows for University of Dublin/Trinity or NUI/constituent colleges.

source_name: List of publicly-funded higher education institutions (universities and colleges)
source_authority_type: Department of Further and Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science / gov.ie
evidence_used: Provides official website links for universities, TUs, institutes of technology and specialist institutions.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Its “Publicly-funded universities” section includes the five TUs, which conflicts with the requested separate TU taxonomy; it omits RCSI from that section. Use the newer HEA category list and statutory sources for classification.

source_name: National University of Ireland 2026 Annual Quality Report
evidence_used: QQI report describes NUI as a federal designated awarding body but not a provider of education; distinguishes its constituent universities and recognised colleges, including RCSI.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Use NUI as an awarding-body relationship, not an additional campus-based university provider. Full PDF was surfaced by official-source search; row-level review not completed.

source_authority_type: RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences / official institution source
evidence_used: States RCSI is a university, a designated awarding body, and was authorised to use university status in 2019; notes its relationship with NUI.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Institution source corroborates status but is not the primary statutory instrument; confirm the enabling order and retain specialist/private classification.
verification_status: STATUS CROSSCHECK; STATUTORY ORDER SHOULD BE ATTACHED

source_name: First 28 institutions authorised to use TrustEd Ireland quality mark
evidence_used: 2026 list includes public HEIs and selected private colleges authorised to use the statutory TrustEd Ireland mark.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Quality-mark cohort is not a complete Irish university or provider universe; use only as an international-student quality/authorisation overlay.

source_name: How many postsecondary institutions are eligible to award federal aid?
source_authority_type: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) / IPEDS
evidence_used: NCES reports 5,581 U.S. postsecondary institutions eligible to award federal student aid in academic year 2025-26; data are provisional.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: This is the broad Title IV postsecondary universe, not a university count; includes sectors and institution levels outside a university catalogue.
verification_status: UNIVERSE BASELINE VERIFIED; INSTITUTION LIST/FILTER PENDING

source_name: 2024-25 IPEDS Data Collection: Fall Provisional Data Release
evidence_used: Memo reports 5,829 expected IPEDS institutions/offices/academies in 2024-25; footnote says 5,760 institutions and 69 administrative offices, with four non-Title-IV service academies included in IPEDS tables. Sector appendix reports 845 public, 1,545 private nonprofit and 301 private for-profit 4-year institutions (2,691 total).
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Counts differ by definition and collection year; 2,691 is a broad 4-year sector baseline, not an extracted current university-only/degree-granting list. Exclude system offices and deduplicate campuses under approved rules.

evidence_used: Describes IPEDS as the Title IV-eligible postsecondary universe and provides level, control, sector, jurisdiction, HBCU/TCU and other grouping variables.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: IPEDS is broad and dynamic; values/definitions vary by collection year. Use the institution-level file for a reproducible filter.

source_name: Database of Accredited Postsecondary Institutions and Programs (DAPIP)
source_authority_type: U.S. Department of Education, Office of Postsecondary Education
evidence_used: Database includes data reported by federally recognized accrediting agencies and state approval agencies.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Department explicitly says it does not accredit institutions and the database is not audited and may not be accurate, current or complete; use as a cross-check, not sole recognition authority.

source_name: Read more information about the Directory of Educational Institutions in Canada
source_authority_type: Canadian Information Centre for International Credentials (CICIC), in consultation with provincial/territorial competent authorities
evidence_used: CICIC says the directory is the only authoritative list of currently recognized, authorized, registered and/or licensed institutions; updated on an ongoing basis; it defines recognized vs specific-credential-authorized vs registered/licensed and provider types.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: CICIC says it is not a competent authority; directory includes schools beyond universities, excludes some exempt providers, and is not a complete programme catalogue. Filter status and credential rights.

source_authority_type: CICIC / Council of Ministers of Education Canada information
evidence_used: States more than 300 public/private Canadian postsecondary institutions can grant degrees; types include universities, university colleges, colleges, Indigenous institutes, polytechnics and specialized institutes.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: “More than 300” is a broad degree-granting estimate, not an exact current university-only count. Province/territory and credential-specific authority must be retained.

source_authority_type: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) / Government of Canada
evidence_used: Lists all public/private postsecondary DLIs, with DLI number, city/campus and public/private status; DLI status is required for study-permit eligibility.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: DLI is a host-international-students/immigration designation, not proof that the provider is a university or has general degree-awarding authority. Use as an overlay.

evidence_used: Explains provincial/territorial recognition and directs users to competent ministries and the CICIC directory for recognized institutions.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: Federal overview; it does not itself supply the full institution roster.

source_name: Ministries/Departments responsible for education in Canada
evidence_used: Provides provincial/territorial competent-authority contacts for institution recognition and degree authority.
limitations_conflicts_or_next_check: All provincial/territorial legal lists and scope variations still require extraction for a final institutional record.
